text:
priya: Quick sync — legal asked for the final PSA/data contract for the Snow+Databricks+Qdrant connector listing. We need confirmation on three things: telemetry retention policy, who owns anonymized telemetry, and SLA wording for marketplace. Can ops/eng + security confirm by EOD?

miguel: For telemetry — default retention 90 days, aggregated only, PII redaction on ingest. We'll provide an opt-out flag in the connector config. Example config:
```json
{"telemetry_retention_days":90, "send_pii":false}
```
We'll also add an env var toggle: `REDWOOD_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=true`

hana: Security OK with 90d aggregated, but legal wants clarity on outbound telemetry endpoints and KMS usage. We need to list which fields are hashed vs removed. I'll attach the redaction spec (short): user_id -> hash, email -> remove, payload -> redact if matches regex.

ben: Product note — SLA for marketplace listing needs to be "availability 99.5% monthly" or "best-effort" depending on whether Dedicated resourced. For hosted API we'll propose 99.5 for the connector pipeline (ingest + transform). That ok with eng?

miguel: 99.5% for ingest pipelines seems doable if we include retry/backoff + circuit breaker. We'll add `max_retries=5`, `backoff_ms=500` default. Also we should spell out maintenance windows in the marketplace listing.

thomas: Partner ask: Snowflake legal wants a short "data handling" blurb for the marketplace tile. Suggested copy: "Redwood Inference connector streams vector metadata to partner-managed storage; telemetry is aggregated and non-PII. See PSA for full terms." Can someone draft final one-liner?

priya: I'll draft. Also coordinating announcement: marketing wants a 2-week feature freeze before joint announcement. Proposed timeline: QA + cert this week, legal/PSA sign-off next Tue, marketplace publish Wed, joint blog two weeks after. Everyone ok?

miguel: timeline +1. We need partner e2e test run to pass before cert. partner-e2e-bot, last run status?

partner-e2e-bot: TEST RUN 2024-11-02 18:32 UTC — connector e2e smoke: PASSED (7/7). Notes: telemetry opt-out validated; sample data scrub rule #3 flagged but auto-redacted. Full log: https://ci.redwood.test/runs/4287

hana: Noted flagged rule — please add explicit rule for SSN patterns; we should ship with that to avoid legal pushback.

miguel: Will add SSN regex: `/(?:\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4})/g` and update docs. Pushed commit `connector/scrub: add ssn regex`.

ben: Marketing: keep announcement text high level. Avoid implying Snowflake stores full vectors — just say 'integrates with Snowflake and Databricks for vector workflows'. I'll share draft.

thomas: Action items: 1) miguel — add SSN regex + maint window clause. 2) hana — KMS endpoints + redaction table. 3) priya — draft marketplace blurb + get legal sign-off. 4) ben — blog draft. Ping @here if anything slips EOD Friday.

priya: Thanks — logging as action items in the partnership tracker. linking to doc: https://docs.redwood/integrations/snow-dbx-qdrant/psa

priya: @miguel if e2e bot fails on next run, can we fall back to partner-hosted sample env for cert? (we may need partner support)

miguel: Yes we can fallback; ask partner eng to open support ticket. thomas can help coordinate.

thomas: I'll reach out to partner eng and loop legal if needed.

partner-e2e-bot: NEXT RUN SCHEDULED 2024-11-03 02:00 UTC — will post results.

priya: OK closing the thread for now. If anything urgent ping me directly. :white_check_mark:
